evidence.idea: We present AgenticTask, an agent-based framework that expands existing task collections under human intent. Its central representation links interaction requirements to object and part bindings, scene and robot configurations, initial conditions, and completion criteria.
bullets: On RoboCasa, the framework builds the AgenticTask collection, saving 16,450 16{,}450 task instances from 20,323 20{,}323 construction attempts
at a throughput of 166.97 166.97 saved instances per elapsed hour, with 62.26 % 62.26\% of construction attempts passing the configured physical checks.
The execution agent completes approximately 38 % 38\% of evaluated tasks, with successful cases spanning object placement, articulated manipulation, and sequential arrangement.
evidence.summary: On RoboCasa, the framework builds the AgenticTask collection, saving 16,450 16{,}450 task instances from 20,323 20{,}323 construction attempts
evidence.practice_takeaway: A task-execution agent uses the same bindings and geometric records to select robot-supported skills and check completion against the original task criteria.

rewrite.headline: AgenticTask saves 16,450 simulated embodied tasks, and an agent completes about 38%
rewrite.idea: Authors from Hubei University, Zhejiang University of Technology, Fudan University and Linctex built it on RoboCasa with generation and execution agents.
